title: Treatment of Botulism
licence_note: US federal government work. Read by R16 (live): antitoxin; ventilator until the person can breathe on their own; some people stay in hospital for weeks or even months.

title: 29 CFR 1910.333, Selection and use of work practices (de-energizing, lockout and tagging, verification of deenergized condition)
licence_note: US federal regulation text. Read by R16 (live): deenergize before work; lockout/tagging; qualified person verifies with test equipment that parts are deenergized; only qualified persons work on energized parts.

title: Recommended Drinks for Children Age 5 & Younger
licence_note: Copyrighted (AAP). Fetch for the household's private copy only. Read by R16: 12-24 months whole milk 16 oz/day (2 cups); children 2 and older nonfat or low-fat milk; water 4-8 oz/day at 6-12 months; toddler milks unnecessary.

title: Diaper Rash
licence_note: Copyrighted (AAP). Fetch for the household's private copy only. Read by R16: yeast clues (shiny bright red or pink patches, sharp edges, worse in groin folds); call if not going away or worse after two to three days of treatment; pediatrician may recommend an antifungal cream.

title: Antifreeze is poisonous to pets and humans, so why keep it around?
org: Purdue University News (College of Veterinary Medicine expert)
licence_note: University news release; copyrighted. Fetch for the household's private copy only. Read by R16: ethylene glycol is sweet tasting; a little licked off a cat's fur can harm it; store where pets and children cannot reach. Replaces the ASPCA landing-page capture (a3f331) on 20-09.

title: People at Increased Risk for Toxoplasmosis
licence_note: US federal government work. Read by R16 (live): for pregnant people, if possible have someone else change cat litter; if no one else can, wear disposable gloves and wash hands with soap and water afterwards.
